title: NAFEMS LE11: cylinder/taper/sphere, thermal load (axisymmetric)
description:
NAFEMS benchmark LE11, solid cylinder/taper/sphere under a temperature load (linear elastic, static, axisymmetric about the z axis).
Geometry: a hollow solid of revolution. The meridian section (r = radial distance from the z axis, z = axial coordinate, metres) is bounded by: the bottom face z = 0 from A = (r 1.0, z 0) to B = (r 1.4, z 0); an outer spherical surface of radius 1.4 centred at the origin from B up to D = (r sqrt(1.4^2 - 0.7^2) = 1.2124, z 0.7); an outer conical taper (straight in the section) from D to G = (r 1.0, z 1.39); an outer cylinder r = 1.0 from G to I = (r 1.0, z 1.79); the top face z = 1.79 from I to H = (r 0.70711, z 1.79); an inner cylinder r = 0.70711 from H down to E = (r 0.70711, z 0.70711), the 45-degree point of the unit circle; and an inner spherical surface of radius 1.0 centred at the origin from E back to A. The body is hollow (it does not reach the axis). The STEP file holds the meridian section in the xy-plane with x = r and y = z (axis of revolution: x = 0).
Material: isotropic linear elastic, E = 210 GPa, Poisson's ratio 0.3, coefficient of thermal expansion 2.3e-4 per degC.
Load: a prescribed temperature field (no heat-transfer analysis needed), linear in the radial and axial directions: T [degC] = sqrt(x^2 + y^2) + z with the axis along z, i.e. T = r + z. The stress-free reference temperature is 0 degC. No mechanical loads.
Supports: bottom face (z = 0, edge AB in the section): zero axial (z) displacement. Top face (z = 1.79, edge HI): zero axial displacement. Radial expansion is free everywhere.
Report: szz_A = axial direct stress sigma_zz at point A (r = 1.0, z = 0), in Pa. (In an axisymmetric model with x = r, y = z this is the yy stress component.)
